name: Sting
description: The small blade that glows blue in darkness. Seven faithful days, and the darkness retreats.

name: Phial of Galadriel
description: A light when all other lights go out. Complete the Psalms track and carry this into the dark.

name: Mithril Coat
description: Worth more than the Shire. Forged in fellowship — all members active in a single week.

name: The One Ring
description: A burden and a prize. Complete a full campaign and bear what others could not.

name: Glamdring
description: The Foe-hammer, sword of Gandalf. Reach level 5 and you carry the light of the Istari.

name: Andúril
description: Reforged from the shards of Narsil. Thirty days of faithfulness, and the blade is remade.

name: Lembas Bread
description: One small bite fills the stomach of a grown man. Complete fifty daily habits — sustained beyond your own strength.

name: The Silmarils
description: The greatest treasures of Arda — light imprisoned in jewels. Complete every campaign and hold the light of the Trees.
